name: Oxford-IIIT Pet probability responses
source_image_copyright: Copyright remains with the original image owners.
contents: Precomputed named-class responses and evaluation annotations; original image pixels, visual embeddings and model weights are not included.
labels: Zero-based named class indices; evaluation only.
score_definition: Candidate-token mean log likelihood, followed by softmax over the fixed class vocabulary. These are candidate-normalized scores rather than calibrated class posteriors.

models.score_definition: mean candidate token log P -> class softmax
models.prompt_system: You are an expert in cat and dog breed identification. Inspect the image carefully and determine its main category. Use visible evidence only.
models.prompt_user:
Identify the breed of the primary cat or dog using visible appearance.

Output only the category name directly.

inductive_protocol.selection: Saved unstratified random 80/20 partitions, identical to the paper; independent of labels.

transductive_protocol: Fit on all 7349 probability rows without labels; evaluate on the same pool.
original_split_note: The original trainval/test identifiers are retained for sample provenance. The paper uses the saved repeated 80/20 partitions, not the official supervised split.
sample_identity: Sample IDs and relative image paths refer to the archived collection order; image SHA-256 values identify exact image bytes.
transformations: Renamed array keys and combined saved arrays into one NPZ. No probability, label, sample ordering, source ordering, class ordering or split index was changed.
